lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: The monks of your order — they train to fight?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: We train to not need to. Fighting is the proof that the training failed.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Your soldiers — what happened to the ones you lost?

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I keep a list. Every name.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Good. Grief held clearly doesn't poison the water.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: I follow the situation. Orders describe the situation as it was when they were written.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: I've known three officers who said that. Two were right.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You lead. It is visible even when you try to hold back.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: If I fall — look after them.
